note: Submodule of graphql_compose. Exposes comments to the schema (read as connections, optional CreateComment mutation). Depends on graphql_compose_edges. The distinctive config key is entity_config.comment.<bundle>.comments_mutation_enabled on graphql_compose.settings.graphql_compose_server. Medium/hard cases are grounded in that key on the comment.comment bundle (baseline: absent). Evals avoid live GraphQL queries and 'drush cr'.

evals.prompt: What does graphql_compose_comments add, and which other GraphQL Compose submodule does it depend on and why?
evals.expected_output: It exposes Drupal comments to the schema (comment threads as cursor-paginated connections, plus an optional CreateComment mutation). It depends on graphql_compose_edges because comment threads are returned as Relay-style connections.

evals.prompt: In graphql_compose_comments, which config key enables the GraphQL mutation that lets users post a comment for a comment bundle?
evals.expected_output: entity_config.comment.<bundle>.comments_mutation_enabled = true (e.g. entity_config.comment.comment.comments_mutation_enabled) in graphql_compose.settings.graphql_compose_server; it enables the CreateComment mutation (still subject to Drupal comment permissions).

evals.prompt: Name a couple of the GraphQL types or data producers graphql_compose_comments provides for resolving comments.
evals.expected_output: SchemaTypes CommentAuthorType and CommentAvailable; DataProducers such as CommentEdge and CreateComment (plus CommentsTypeBundleSplit / CommentsArrayKey / CommentsArrayWrap).

evals.prompt: On this site the comment posting mutation has been enabled for a comment bundle in GraphQL Compose. Inspect the config and state which comment bundle has comment mutation enabled.
Using graphql_compose_comments, enable the comment posting mutation for the 'comment' comment bundle on the default GraphQL Compose server. Apply the change to the live configuration.
